ChangedDecoders: PDF417 pixel recovery reads surviving right indicators and suffix data after left framing is cropped. Independent logical rows establish column count, row count and correction level; absent prefix characters remain erasures for the existing correction and payload checks.

After ordinary pixel reading fails, validated left framing can anchor other rows whose start patterns are damaged and whose missing stop joins the final indicator space to the image edge. Complete data, both row indicators, physical row order and the visible right-indicator runs remain required.

Recovery retains at most 32 right-framing sets per orientation/slope, 16 left-framing anchors and eight word alternatives per row. Existing deadlines, cancellation, ordinary-pass priority, format hints, payload oracles and scoring remain unchanged. No public API, production dependency or test-only hook is introduced.
AttributionLimits: This follow-up records 219/267 correct positive images versus 219/267 previously; gained: none; previously correct positive images lost: none. Paired negative completion is [29, 29, 30, 28]/31 currently and [29, 30, 28, 29]/31 previously. PDF417 framing recovery changes recognition hypotheses within the original allowance. Paired nineteen-image costs and nine-request retail costs remain separate, with every sample and recognition failure retained. No recognition allowance, hint, oracle or scoring change. Supplemental PDF417 images are regression evidence informed by this remediation, not an unseen holdout. Invalid GS1 AI (3922) oracles and undeclared QR encoding policies remain unchanged. Shared-host contention and budgets affect results. Stacked DataBar/Expanded Stacked multiple-symbol localization and arbitrary perspective remain unproved; MaxiCode image scanning is unsupported. These finite workloads do not establish overall superiority.
